title: Message Consumer Crash in Inventory Service Due to Poison Message
description: Inventory service Kafka consumer crashes on a malformed message (missing required field). Consumer restarts but immediately crashes on same message, creating crash loop. No inventory updates processed for 30 minutes.
initial_symptoms: Inventory service pods restarting every 30 seconds
Kafka consumer lag: 100k messages and growing
Order service unable to reserve inventory
Consumer logs show NullPointerException on message field
